dicej opened PR #14367 from dicej:fix-unreachable-traps to bytecodealliance:main:

PR #14342 included some unreachable code due partly to some code in wast.rs which only compared the first part of trap message strings which began with "cannot read" or "cannot write", leading me to think that certain code paths were being exercised when they really weren't. To avoid future confusion, I've removed those special cases in wast.rs and updated the code in futures_and_streams.rs to match the expected messages in the spec tests, as well as updating a couple of WAST tests we host locally in this repo.

Finally, this updates the tests/component-model submodule to include the new idle-drop.wast tests I mentioned in the earlier PR which have since been merged.

Fixes #14360
